stanzas.sanskrit:
जातस्य ध्रुवकुल एव तुङ्गकीर्ते-
-रङ्गस्य व्यजनि सुतः स वेननामा ।
तद्दोषव्यथितमतिः स राजवर्य-
-स्त्वत्पादे निहितमना वनं गतोऽभूत् ॥ १८-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
In the popular dynasty of Dhruva, came the King Angan who was married to Suneetha.
Venan was their son who was very wicked and cruel. Due to Venan's illegal actions, King Angan left to forest to perform penance and attained mukthi.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
jātasya dhruvakula eva tuṅgakīrte-
-raṅgasya vyajani sutaḥ sa venanāmā |
taddoṣavyathitamatiḥ sa rājavarya-
-stvatpāde nihitamanā vanaṃ gato’bhūt || 18-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
पापोऽपि क्षितितलपालनाय वेनः
पौराद्यैरुपनिहितः कठोरवीर्यः ।
सर्वेभ्यो निजबलमेव सम्प्रशंसन्
भूचक्रे तव यजनान्ययं न्यरौत्सीत् ॥ १८-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
Venan gave lot of troubles to the people of the kingdom and declared that Lord does not exist.
Venan neglected the welfare of the people, destroyed sacrificial rites and conducted by Sages.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
pāpo’pi kṣititalapālanāya venaḥ
paurādyairupanihitaḥ kaṭhoravīryaḥ |
sarvebhyo nijabalameva sampraśaṃsan
bhūcakre tava yajanānyayaṃ nyarautsīt || 18-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सम्प्राप्ते हितकथनाय तापसौघे
मत्तोऽन्यो भुवनपतिर्न कश्चनेति ।
त्वन्निन्दावचनपरो मुनीश्वरैस्तैः
शापाग्नौ शलभदशामनायि वेनः ॥ १८-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: He considered himself as the supreme power in the universe. Sages were very angry with him and cursed Venan. The flame which rose from the sages burnt Venan down.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
samprāpte hitakathanāya tāpasaughe
matto’nyo bhuvanapatirna kaścaneti |
tvannindāvacanaparo munīśvaraistaiḥ
śāpāgnau śalabhadaśāmanāyi venaḥ || 18-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तन्नाशात्खलजनभीरुकैर्मुनीन्द्रै-
-स्तन्मात्रा चिरपरिरक्षिते तदङ्गे ।
त्यक्ताघे परिमथितादथोरुदण्डा-
-द्दोर्दण्डे परिमथिते त्वमाविरासीः ॥ १८-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
The sages feared that the absence of a ruler would lead to the involvement of wicked people. So Sages took the body of Venan from his mother who was preserving it for a long time and churned the thighs of his body.
Then when his arms were churned, from there Lord appeared in the form of Prithu.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tannāśātkhalajanabhīrukairmunīndrai-
-stanmātrā ciraparirakṣite tadaṅge |
tyaktāghe parimathitādathorudaṇḍā-
-ddordaṇḍe parimathite tvamāvirāsīḥ || 18-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
विख्यातः पृथुरिति तापसोपदिष्टैः
सूताद्यैः परिणुतभाविभूरिवीर्यः ।
वेनार्त्या कबलितसम्पदं धरित्री-
-माक्रान्तां निजधनुषा समामकार्षीः ॥ १८-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Due to the misdoings of Venan like stopping of Sacrifices by him, Mother Earth Goddess retracted and hid all its resources. King Prithu attacked Cow Earth with his bow and arrow asking her to yield back all the resources.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vikhyātaḥ pṛthuriti tāpasopadiṣṭaiḥ
sūtādyaiḥ pariṇutabhāvibhūrivīryaḥ |
venārtyā kabalitasampadaṃ dharitrī-
-mākrāntāṃ nijadhanuṣā samāmakārṣīḥ || 18-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
भूयस्तां निजकुलमुख्यवत्सयुक्तै-
-र्देवाद्यैः समुचितचारुभाजनेषु ।
अन्नादीन्यभिलषितानि यानि तानि
स्वच्छन्दं सुरभितनूमदूदुहस्त्वम् ॥ १८-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
Mother Earth accepted to yield back and made the earth green and prosperous as before.
King Prithu is mainly associated with the legend of his chasing the earth goddess, Prithvi, who fled in the form of a cow and eventually agreed to yield her milk as the world's grain and vegetation.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhūyastāṃ nijakulamukhyavatsayuktai-
-rdevādyaiḥ samucitacārubhājaneṣu |
annādīnyabhilaṣitāni yāni tāni
svacchandaṃ surabhitanūmadūduhastvam || 18-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
आत्मानं यजति मखैस्त्वयि त्रिधाम-
-न्नारब्धे शततमवाजिमेधयागे ।
स्पर्धालुः शतमख एत्य नीचवेषो
हृत्वाऽश्वं तव तनयात् पराजितोऽभूत् ॥ १८-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: King Prithu did aswamedha yagnas and when he was to complete the 100th, Lord Indra feeling jealous, came in disguise and stole the horse. King Prithu's son went and defeated Indra and brought back the horse.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ātmānaṃ yajati makhaistvayi tridhāma-
-nnārabdhe śatatamavājimedhayāge |
spardhāluḥ śatamakha etya nīcaveṣo
hṛtvā’śvaṃ tava tanayāt parājito’bhūt || 18-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
देवेन्द्रं मुहुरिति वाजिनं हरन्तं
वह्नौ तं मुनिवरमण्डले जुहूषौ ।
रुन्धाने कमलभवे क्रतोः समाप्तौ
साक्षात् त्वं मधुरिपुमैक्षथाः स्वयं स्वम् ॥ १८-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Indra repeatedly tried to steal the yagna horse. King Prithu went to fight with Indra. Brahma intervened and requested to spare Indra. Lord manifested in Vishnu Form.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
devendraṃ muhuriti vājinaṃ harantaṃ
vahnau taṃ munivaramaṇḍale juhūṣau |
rundhāne kamalabhave kratoḥ samāptau
sākṣāt tvaṃ madhuripumaikṣathāḥ svayaṃ svam || 18-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तद्दत्तं वरमुपलभ्य भक्तिमेकां
गङ्गान्ते विहितपदः कदापि देव ।
सत्रस्थं मुनिनिवहं हितानि शंस-
-न्नैक्षिष्ठाः सनकमुखान् मुनीन् पुरस्तात् ॥ १८-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
Lord Vishnu wanted to grant boon to the King. King Prithu asked for only one boon of being devoted to Lord as always.
Settled in the banks of Ganga, one day when Prithu was explaining about dharma to sages assembled there, Sanaka with divine sages appeared there.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
taddattaṃ varamupalabhya bhaktimekāṃ
gaṅgānte vihitapadaḥ kadāpi deva |
satrasthaṃ muninivahaṃ hitāni śaṃsa-
-nnaikṣiṣṭhāḥ sanakamukhān munīn purastāt || 18-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
विज्ञानं सनकमुखोदितं दधानः
स्वात्मानं स्वयमगमो वनान्तसेवी ।
तत्तादृक् पृथुवपुरीश सत्वरं मे
रोगौघं प्रशमय वातगेहवासिन् ॥ १८-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Sanaka advised King Prithu to go to forest and do penance. King Prithu following their advice, attained salvation and merged with the Lord.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vijñānaṃ sanakamukhoditaṃ dadhānaḥ
svātmānaṃ svayamagamo vanāntasevī |
tattādṛk pṛthuvapurīśa satvaraṃ me
rogaughaṃ praśamaya vātagehavāsin || 18-10 ||
